purpose: Read-only governed registry for pipeline planning, backend status, and infrastructure review.

integrations.name: Ponytail restraint guard

integrations.rollback: Remove the restraint trait from the affected Veloce loop contract.

integrations.name: Headroom context compression
integrations.dataBoundary: No upstream runtime or proxy may receive production tenant data.

integrations.name: OpenReply Instagram pilot
integrations.dataBoundary: No direct Veloce connection or sensitive-data copy; human-approved campaign records only.
activationEvidence: reviewed upstream commit with no critical/high advisories
integrations.rollback: Disable campaign, pause the isolated worker, revoke Meta permissions, and rotate OpenReply-only secrets.

integrations.name: VoxCPM private voice pilot
integrations.dataBoundary: No public ingress, third-party voice cloning, tenant data bridge, or automatic delivery.
integrations.rollback: Disable worker ingress, revoke worker-only credentials, and delete pilot audio artifacts under retention policy.

integrations.name: Scout lead-research candidate
integrations.dataBoundary: Human-approved public profile URLs only; no cookies, proxies, raw-lead import, contact storage, or automatic outreach.
integrations.rollback: Disable the manual research workflow and remove any approved aggregate brief from the campaign review queue.
